## Checklist

### Code

- [ ] My title and commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`fix(scope):`, `feat(scope):`, etc.)
- [ ] I searched existing issues and PRs for duplicates
- [ ] This PR contains one focused logical change
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes
- [ ] `go test -race ./...` passes
- [ ] `go vet ./...` passes
- [ ] I tested on: <!-- e.g. Ubuntu 26.04, macOS 15, Windows 11 -->

### Security, privacy, and documentation

- [ ] Mail operations remain read-only, or N/A
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated, or N/A
- [ ] Cross-platform impact was considered, or N/A
- [ ] Dependency or GitHub Action changes are pinned and reviewed, or N/A
